changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud WAF Bot Management Automation Skill.

- Automates WAF Bot Management configuration using Alibaba Cloud CLI.
- Supports various scenarios: LLM API protection, retail anti-scalper, general anti-crawling, and academic research platforms.
- Guides users through data collection, environment checks, and scenario-specific follow-up questions.
- Performs automated CLI assessments of WAF instance and Bot Management readiness, with clear error handling strategies.
- Recommends and applies rule templates per scenario; outputs rollback tips if partial failures occur.
- Provides operational checklists and SDK integration reminders to ensure successful bot mitigation deployment.
